name: week
title: Drawing control this week
subtitle: Fictional demo when seeded. Read-only record checks, not engineering approval.

sections.title: Drawing register
sections.sql: select number,title,site,approved_revision,latest_revision,latest_status,pending_reviews from drawing_register order by number

sections.title: Outstanding reviews
sections.sql: select number,revision,reviewer,due_on,days_overdue from review_queue order by due_on

sections.title: Acknowledgements and old revisions
sections.sql: select reference,recipient,due_on,acknowledged_at,drawings,superseded_items from handover_register order by reference
sections.note: An acknowledgement does not make an obsolete drawing current.

sections.title: Records needing review
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by number,rule
sections.note: Evidence checks only. A qualified person reviews the actual design and applicable duties.
